creators.name: Pak
creators.role: Anonymous digital artist and system designer
creators.bio: Anonymous digital creator who also built the image-curating bot Archillect (2014). Between 2020 and 2022 Pak released a run of sales and contracts on Nifty Gateway, Sotheby's and their own sites: open editions, the ASH burn token, Lost Poets, Merge and Censored.
creators.why: Pak turned sale formats and contract rules (open editions, burning, merging, one-token-per-wallet) into the artwork itself, so that what tens of thousands of buyers did is the finished piece.
creators.role_zh: 匿名数字艺术家、系统设计者
creators.bio_zh: 匿名数字创作者，2014 年做过图像策展机器人 Archillect。2020 至 2022 年间，Pak 在 Nifty Gateway、苏富比和自建网站上接连推出一系列发售与合约：开放版数、ASH 销毁代币、Lost Poets、Merge 和 Censored。
creators.why_zh: Pak 把发售形式和合约规则（开放版数、销毁、合并、每个钱包只能持有一枚）本身做成作品，数万名买家的行为就是作品的最终形态。

creators.name: Jack Butcher
creators.role: Conceptual artist, founder of Visualize Value
creators.bio: Artist and founder of Visualize Value, known for works built from simple signs (a checkmark, a receipt, a trademark symbol). Since 2023 he has made editions whose images and supply are changed by collectors, often with developer Jalil Wahdatehagh.
creators.why: Checks and Opepen made compositing-by-burning and holder opt-in into widely copied protocol forms, and his later works keep testing how a buyer's choice changes a shared work.
creators.role_zh: 观念艺术家，Visualize Value 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，Visualize Value 创始人，作品常由简单符号构成（对勾、收据、商标符号）。自 2023 年起，他常与开发者 Jalil Wahdatehagh 合作，做出一系列由藏家改变图像与供应量的版数作品。
creators.why_zh: Checks 和 Opepen 让“烧毁合成”和“持有者自愿加入”成为被广泛模仿的协议形式；他之后的作品继续检验买家的一次选择如何改变一件共有的作品。

creators.name: Damien Hirst
creators.bio: British artist and a leading figure of the Young British Artists. With HENI he released The Currency (2021), his first NFT project.
creators.why: The Currency made each buyer choose between a token and a painting, and destroyed whichever they rejected, so the final shape of 10,000 works was set by collectors.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，“英国青年艺术家”群体的代表人物。他与 HENI 合作推出了自己的第一个 NFT 项目 The Currency（2021）。
creators.why_zh: The Currency 让每位买家在代币和画作之间二选一，未被选中的一方会被销毁，于是一万件作品最后的样子由藏家决定。

creators.name: Tom Sachs
creators.bio: American sculptor known for hand-built replicas of space programmes and branded objects. Rocket Factory (2021) is his NFT project, in which collectors assemble rockets from parts that his studio then builds and launches.
creators.why: Rocket Factory ties an on-chain merge rule (three parts burned into one rocket) to a physical studio process and public launches.
creators.bio_zh: 美国雕塑家，以手工复制太空计划和品牌物件著称。Rocket Factory（2021）是他的 NFT 项目：藏家用零件拼装火箭，再由他的工作室把火箭造出来并发射。
creators.why_zh: Rocket Factory 把链上的合并规则（三个零件烧成一枚火箭）与工作室的实体制作和公开发射联系在一起。

creators.name: Mitchell F. Chan
creators.bio: Artist working with conceptual art, video games and smart contracts. His 2017 token work Digital Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility restages Yves Klein's receipt ritual in an Ethereum contract.
creators.why: Digital Zones is an early smart contract that encodes an artist's sale ritual, including a burn function any holder can call.
creators.bio_zh: 创作涉及观念艺术、电子游戏和智能合约的艺术家。他 2017 年的代币作品 Digital Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility 把伊夫·克莱因的收据仪式搬进以太坊合约。
creators.why_zh: Digital Zones 是较早把艺术家的出售仪式写进智能合约的作品，其中包括任何持有者都能调用的销毁函数。

works.title: The Fungible
works.description: Pak's sale with Sotheby's on Nifty Gateway (12–14 April 2021): identical 'cubes' were sold as an open edition for 15 minutes a day, and each buyer's cubes were then packed into NFTs whose image depends on how many they bought.
works.description_zh: Pak 与苏富比在 Nifty Gateway 上的发售（2021 年 4 月 12 日至 14 日）：完全相同的“方块”以开放版数每天只卖 15 分钟，之后每位买家的方块按购买数量打包成不同画面的 NFT。
works.idea_en: Sell a fungible unit and let the quantity each person buys decide which non-fungible artwork they end up holding.
works.idea_zh: 卖的是可互换的单位，每人买多少决定他最后拿到哪件不可互换的作品。
works.protocol: Anyone could buy any number of cubes during a 15-minute window each day, at $500, then $1,000, then $1,500. After the sale each buyer's total was split into the largest possible packs: A Cube (1), Five, Ten, Twenty, Fifty, Hundred, Five Hundred and Thousand Cubes (six cubes = one Five Cubes + one A Cube). The top buyer received The Cube, the next 100 buyers received Complexity, and Equilibrium went to four winners of set challenges (puzzle, highest secondary purchase, largest #PakWasHere post, closest estimate of the total).
works.protocol_zh: 每天 15 分钟的窗口内，任何人都可以买任意数量的方块，三天价格依次为 500、1000、1500 美元。发售结束后，每位买家的总数被拆成尽可能大的包：A Cube（1）、Five、Ten、Twenty、Fifty、Hundred、Five Hundred 和 Thousand Cubes（买六个 = 一个 Five Cubes 加一个 A Cube）。买得最多的人获得 The Cube，其后 100 人获得 Complexity；Equilibrium 的四个版本分别给解谜者、二级市场最高价买家、#PakWasHere 帖子受众最大者和最接近总成交额的预测者。
works.collective: Buyers took 19,737 cubes on day one, 3,268 on day two and 593 on day three: 23,598 cubes for about $14 million. With the two auctioned 1/1s (The Switch, The Pixel) the sale reached $16.8 million (Sotheby's). Many cube holders later burned their cubes on burn.art to mine ASH.
works.collective_zh: 买家第一天买下 19,737 个方块，第二天 3,268 个，第三天 593 个，共 23,598 个，约 1,400 万美元。加上两件拍卖的单版作品（The Switch、The Pixel），整场销售额为 1,680 万美元（据苏富比）。许多方块持有者后来在 burn.art 上销毁方块以挖取 ASH。

works.title: burn.art and $ASH
works.description: A site where anyone can destroy an NFT and receive ASH, an ERC-20 token that started with zero supply and can only be mined by burning. ASH then became the only currency accepted for some Pak drops.
works.description_zh: 一个任何人都可以在上面销毁 NFT、换取 ASH 的网站。ASH 是一种初始供应为零、只能靠销毁挖出的 ERC-20 代币，后来成为部分 Pak 发售唯一接受的货币。
works.idea_en: A currency backed by what its holders have destroyed: every burn makes the remaining works rarer.
works.idea_zh: 一种以持有者销毁之物为支撑的货币：每销毁一件，剩下的就更稀少。
works.protocol: Any holder can burn an NFT on burn.art and receive newly minted ASH. The yield follows a bonding curve that falls as supply grows, with two tiers: Pak NFTs start at 1,000 ASH, all other NFTs at 2 ASH; a halving hits every tier at 5 million ASH. Liquidity pools are left to the community. From January 2022 (Chapter One: Carbon) some Pak drops could only be bought or bid on with ASH.
works.protocol_zh: 任何持有者都可以在 burn.art 上销毁一件 NFT，换取新铸造的 ASH。产出按供应量递减的联合曲线计算，分两档：Pak 的 NFT 起始为 1000 ASH，其他 NFT 起始为 2 ASH；供应达到 500 万时所有档位减半。流动性池由社区自行建立。自 2022 年 1 月（Chapter One: Carbon）起，部分 Pak 发售只能用 ASH 购买或出价。
works.collective: Collectors burned their own and others' NFTs, above all Fungible cubes, to mine ASH; Carbon's single edition is titled 'Three Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty Five Burned Cubes', and only ASH holders could bid on it. By September 2026 the ASH contract showed about 3.54 million tokens held by about 9,950 addresses (Blockscout).
works.collective_zh: 藏家销毁自己和他人的 NFT（尤其是 The Fungible 的方块）来挖 ASH；Carbon 的单版作品题为“Three Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty Five Burned Cubes”（三千八百二十五个被烧掉的方块），只有 ASH 持有者能出价。截至 2026 年 9 月，ASH 合约显示约 354 万枚代币，分布在约 9,950 个地址中（据 Blockscout）。

works.title: Lost Poets
works.description: A collectible strategy game in acts: 65,536 Pages were sold in September 2021, holders burned Pages to claim AI-generated Poets, then burned more Pages to name their Poets and give them words.
works.description_zh: 一个分幕进行的收藏策略游戏：2021 年 9 月售出 65,536 张 Pages，持有者销毁 Pages 领取 AI 生成的 Poets，再继续销毁 Pages 为自己的 Poet 命名、赋予词语。
works.idea_en: Give buyers a fuel (Pages) that can only be spent by destroying it, and let them spend it on authoring the characters they own.
works.idea_zh: 给买家一种只能靠销毁来使用的燃料（Pages），让他们用它来书写自己拥有的角色。
works.protocol: Act I sold Pages (an ERC-1155 token) at 0.32 ETH, with 7,586 Pages airdropped to holders of at least 25 ASH. For two weeks one Page could be burned to claim one Poet (ERC-721); after that no more conversions were possible. 1,024 Origin Poets with special permissions were distributed at random. Burning further Pages into a Poet grants a name change and a few words that the holder can write into the Poet's metadata.
works.protocol_zh: 第一幕以 0.32 ETH 出售 Pages（ERC-1155 代币），另向持有至少 25 ASH 的地址空投 7,586 张。之后两周内，一张 Page 可销毁换取一个 Poet（ERC-721），期限过后不能再转换。1,024 个拥有特殊权限的 Origin Poet 随机分发。再把 Pages 烧进 Poet，可以获得一次改名机会和几个词，持有者可把这些词写进 Poet 的元数据。
works.collective: All 65,536 Pages sold in about two hours of a planned 48-hour sale. Holders then named their Poets and inscribed short lines (on-chain names include 'The Last Poet' and 'Pope Francis'), so the collection's texts were written by its owners. In September 2026 the Poets contract listed about 5,570 holders (Blockscout).
works.collective_zh: 原定 48 小时的发售中，65,536 张 Pages 约两小时售罄。持有者随后给 Poets 起名、刻写短句（链上名称包括“The Last Poet”“Pope Francis”），整套作品的文字由藏家写成。2026 年 9 月，Poets 合约约有 5,570 个持有地址（据 Blockscout）。

works.title: Merge
works.description: An open sale of 'mass' on Nifty Gateway (2–4 December 2021). Each buyer's units became one dynamic token, and any two tokens that meet in the same wallet fuse, so the number of tokens only goes down.
works.description_zh: 2021 年 12 月 2 日至 4 日在 Nifty Gateway 上公开出售的“质量”（mass）。每位买家的单位合成一枚动态代币；任何两枚代币只要进入同一个钱包就会融合，所以代币总数只减不增。
works.idea_en: A game of extinction: a contract where every transfer can consume a token, so the market itself shrinks the work toward one survivor.
works.idea_zh: 一场灭绝游戏：每次转移都可能吞掉一枚代币，市场本身把作品一步步缩向唯一的幸存者。
works.protocol: During the 48-hour sale anyone could buy any number of mass units; at the end each collector's units were merged into one token. The contract lets an ordinary wallet hold only one token: when a second arrives, the larger mass absorbs the smaller and the smaller is burned (whitelisted addresses such as the Nifty Gateway omnibus are exempt). Each token has one of four classes, drawn as a white, yellow, blue-ringed or red-ringed sphere; the single largest mass is the 'alpha', drawn black with a white ring, and every sphere is sized relative to it.
works.protocol_zh: 48 小时发售期间，任何人都可以买任意数量的质量单位；结束时，每位藏家的单位合并为一枚代币。合约规定普通钱包只能持有一枚：第二枚到达时，质量大的吞并质量小的，小的被销毁（Nifty Gateway 托管地址等白名单地址除外）。每枚代币属于四个等级之一，分别画成白色、黄色、蓝环或红环的球体；全场质量最大的一枚是“alpha”，画成带白环的黑球，其余球体的大小都相对它来计算。
works.collective: 28,983 collectors spent $91,806,519 on 312,686 units of mass, which became one token each (Nifty Gateway / Gemini). Secondary trading and deliberate merging then consumed tokens: by September 2026 the contract's totalSupply was 18,961, held by about 9,635 addresses (Blockscout).
works.collective_zh: 28,983 位藏家花费 91,806,519 美元买下 312,686 个质量单位，每人合成一枚代币（据 Nifty Gateway / Gemini）。此后的二级交易和有意合并不断吞掉代币：截至 2026 年 9 月，合约的 totalSupply 为 18,961，分布在约 9,635 个地址中（据 Blockscout）。

works.title: Matter* (mass.black)
works.description: A month-long 'treasure hunt' for Merge holders (1–30 April 2022): new Matter* tokens were awarded to Merge tokens that met published criteria about merges and mass at the end snapshot.
works.description_zh: 为 Merge 持有者设计的一个月“寻宝”（2022 年 4 月 1 日至 30 日）：按照公布的合并次数与质量标准，在结束快照时符合条件的 Merge 代币获得新的 Matter* 代币。
works.idea_en: Reward specific collective behaviours (merging often, hoarding mass, cannibalising) so holders play the contract as a game.
works.idea_zh: 奖励特定的集体行为（频繁合并、囤积质量、互相吞并），让持有者把合约当作游戏来玩。
works.protocol: Tiers of Matter* went to Merge tokens by rule: 'Hunters and Traps' for tokens with 4+ merges, 'Thief's Wise Hands' for mass × merges ≥ 100 (stealing supply from 'Scavenger's Weak Hands', mass ≥ 10), 'Cannibalism' for the most merges, 'Kings of the Hill' for the most mass, 'Titan' for the alpha, 'Three Lucky Giants' at random, and a hidden challenge tier that would unlock only if Merge supply fell below 20,000. Distribution used the end snapshot; one token could win several.
works.protocol_zh: Matter* 各层级按规则发给 Merge 代币：合并 4 次以上得“Hunters and Traps”；质量 × 合并次数 ≥ 100 得“Thief's Wise Hands”（从质量 ≥ 10 的“Scavenger's Weak Hands”中抢走名额）；合并最多得“Cannibalism”；质量最大得“Kings of the Hill”；alpha 得“Titan”；另有随机抽取的“Three Lucky Giants”，以及只有在 Merge 总量跌破 20,000 时才会解锁的隐藏挑战层。按结束快照分发，一枚代币可以赢得多个。
works.collective: The site reports a Matter* supply of 1,481 with 1,395 generated. The 'Thief' tier took all 450 places, so 'Scavenger's Weak Hands' generated none, and the challenge tier stayed locked because Merge supply did not fall below 20,000 during the event.
works.collective_zh: 网站显示 Matter* 总量为 1,481，实际生成 1,395 枚。“Thief”层级拿走了全部 450 个名额，因此“Scavenger's Weak Hands”一枚也没有生成；活动期间 Merge 总量没有跌破 20,000，挑战层始终未解锁。

works.title: Censored
works.description: An open edition made with Julian Assange (February 2022): for 48 hours anyone could mint a token carrying a message of their own, shown under a black censor bar until Assange was freed.
works.description_zh: 与朱利安·阿桑奇合作的开放版数（2022 年 2 月）：48 小时内任何人都可以铸造一枚写有自己留言的代币，留言被黑色审查条遮住，直到阿桑奇获释。
works.idea_en: Every buyer writes part of the work, and a real-world event (a prisoner's release) is the key that reveals it.
works.idea_zh: 每位买家写下作品的一部分，而一个现实事件（囚徒获释）是揭开它的钥匙。
works.protocol: During the 48-hour window buyers paid any amount they chose and tokenized a message; there was no limit on the number of messages. Each token stores its text and its initial price on-chain and renders the message covered by a censor bar, with a 'Censored' trait that was to switch off only on Assange's release.
works.protocol_zh: 48 小时窗口内，买家自定金额，把一条留言铸成代币，数量不设上限。每枚代币在链上保存文字和初始价格，渲染时留言被审查条遮住；“Censored”属性只有在阿桑奇获释时才会关闭。
works.collective: Tens of thousands of buyers wrote messages (token ids on the contract run past 29,700; initial prices range from 0.01 ETH upward). In June 2024, after Assange's release, Pak uncensored the tokens; the contract lists about 18,500 holders in September 2026 (Blockscout).
works.collective_zh: 数万名买家写下留言（合约上的代币编号超过 29,700，初始价格从 0.01 ETH 起不等）。2024 年 6 月阿桑奇获释后，Pak 解除了代币的审查；2026 年 9 月合约约有 18,500 个持有地址（据 Blockscout）。

works.title: Clock
works.description: The single-edition token of Censored: a counter of the days Julian Assange had spent in prison, updated daily. It was auctioned in February 2022 and bought by AssangeDAO, a crowd-funded collective.
works.description_zh: Censored 系列中的单版代币：一个每天更新、记录朱利安·阿桑奇在狱中天数的计数器。2022 年 2 月拍卖，由众筹集体 AssangeDAO 买下。
works.idea_en: A 1/1 whose only content is a running count of a political fact, sold so that a crowd had to organise to own it.
works.idea_zh: 一件单版作品，内容只是一个政治事实的持续计数；它的出售方式迫使一群人组织起来才能拥有它。
works.protocol: Token #1 of the Censored contract renders the number of days of Assange's imprisonment and changes every day; it was sold at auction to fund Assange's legal defence. The clock was set to stop on his release.
works.protocol_zh: Censored 合约的 1 号代币显示阿桑奇被关押的天数，每天变化；它通过拍卖出售，为阿桑奇的法律辩护筹款。时钟设定在他获释时停止。
works.collective: AssangeDAO pooled ETH from more than 10,000 contributors through Juicebox (as reported by the DAO and press) and won the auction with 16,593 ETH, about $52.8 million at the time. The token now sits in a multisig safe; the clock stopped when Assange was freed in June 2024.
works.collective_zh: AssangeDAO 通过 Juicebox 从一万多名出资者那里汇集 ETH（据该 DAO 与媒体报道），以 16,593 ETH（当时约 5,280 万美元）赢得拍卖。这枚代币现存于一个多签钱包中；2024 年 6 月阿桑奇获释时，时钟停止。

works.title: Checks
works.description: An $8 open edition of 80 checkmarks (January 2023), after Twitter began selling verification. From February 2023 collectors could destroy an edition to get an on-chain Original, then burn Originals into composites with fewer and fewer checks.
works.description_zh: 一件 8 美元、画着 80 个对勾的开放版数作品（2023 年 1 月），缘起于推特开始出售认证标志。自 2023 年 2 月起，藏家可以销毁版数换取链上 Original，再把 Originals 烧成对勾越来越少的合成作品。
works.idea_en: Collectors decide which images survive: every composite destroys a work, and choosing not to act is also part of the piece.
works.idea_zh: 由藏家决定哪些图像存活：每一次合成都销毁一件作品，而选择不动也是作品的一部分。
works.protocol: Checks – VV Edition was open for 24 hours at $8. Any holder may, with no deadline, burn an Edition to mint an Original with the same token number, rendered as an animated SVG from on-chain data. Two Originals with the same check count can be composited into one: 80 → 40 → 20 → 10 → 5 → 4 → 1 check; the holder picks which token number survives and the parents set the colours. At the last stage 64 single checks make a Black Check, the sum of 4,096 original editions, so at most three can ever exist.
works.protocol_zh: Checks – VV Edition 以 8 美元开放 24 小时。持有者可随时（不设期限）销毁一个 Edition，铸造同编号的 Original，其图像是由链上数据生成的动态 SVG。两个对勾数相同的 Originals 可以合成为一个：80 → 40 → 20 → 10 → 5 → 4 → 1；持有者选择保留哪个编号，颜色由两个“父本”决定。最后一步，64 个单对勾合成一个 Black Check，相当于 4,096 个原始版数，因此最多只能存在三个。
works.collective: 16,031 editions were minted in the first 24 hours. By September 2026 about 3,560 Editions had never been migrated and the Originals contract held 5,347 surviving works, so collectors have burned thousands of tokens through migration and compositing (Blockscout).
works.collective_zh: 最初 24 小时内共铸造 16,031 个版数。截至 2026 年 9 月，约 3,560 个 Edition 从未迁移，Originals 合约中存活 5,347 件作品——藏家通过迁移与合成已销毁数千枚代币（据 Blockscout）。

works.title: Opepen Edition
works.description: 16,000 identical tokens (a geometric Pepe) that became a release system: artists propose sets of images, and holders opt their unrevealed tokens into the sets they want to become.
works.description_zh: 16,000 枚相同的代币（一个几何化的 Pepe），后来变成一套发布系统：艺术家提交图像套组，持有者把尚未揭示的代币报名进自己想成为的那一套。
works.idea_en: Holders do not vote on proposals; they commit their own token to the image it will become.
works.idea_zh: 持有者不是对提案投票，而是把自己的代币押在它将变成的那张图像上。
works.protocol: Opepen was a 60-minute open edition (8 January 2023). Tokens are revealed in sets of 80 with edition groups of 1, 4, 5, 10, 20 and 40. Holders of unrevealed tokens sign messages to opt into a proposed set; a set is released once opt-in demand reaches twice its supply, and tokens are then chosen at random, so opting in does not guarantee an allocation. Since March 2024 each token may opt into one set at a time; anyone may submit a set.
works.protocol_zh: Opepen 是 60 分钟的开放版数（2023 年 1 月 8 日）。代币以每套 80 枚的方式揭示，分为 1、4、5、10、20、40 六个版数组。未揭示代币的持有者通过签名报名某个提案套组；报名量达到供应量的两倍时该套发布，再随机抽取代币，所以报名不保证分配到。自 2024 年 3 月起，每枚代币同一时间只能报名一套；任何人都可以提交套组。
works.collective: Set 001 (8x8, by Butcher) was submitted on 30 April 2023 and reached consensus on 3 May 2023; later sets came from many artists. In September 2026 the contract counted 15,766 tokens held by about 8,500 addresses (Blockscout).
works.collective_zh: Set 001（8x8，Butcher 本人作品）于 2023 年 4 月 30 日提交，5 月 3 日达成共识；此后的套组来自众多艺术家。2026 年 9 月，合约记录 15,766 枚代币，分布在约 8,500 个地址中（据 Blockscout）。

works.title: 1 of 1 of ?
works.description: One image issued twice in May 2024: as a unique inscription auctioned at Sotheby's and as a 24-hour open edition. The artist promised to sign a physical work once for every open edition sold.
works.description_zh: 同一张图像在 2024 年 5 月以两种方式发行：一件在苏富比拍卖的唯一铭文，以及一个 24 小时开放版数。艺术家承诺每卖出一个开放版数，就在一件实体作品上签一次名。
works.idea_en: The crowd sets the edition size, and the edition size sets how much physical labour the artist owes.
works.idea_zh: 人群决定版数，版数决定艺术家欠下多少体力劳动。
works.protocol: For 24 hours anyone could collect the open edition; the unique version was auctioned separately the next day. Butcher's release statement committed him to one hand-drawn signature per open edition on an ink-on-Tyvek work (Proof of Work).
works.protocol_zh: 24 小时内任何人都可以收藏开放版数；唯一版次日另行拍卖。Butcher 在发布声明中承诺：每个开放版数，他都要在一件 Tyvek 纸上的墨水作品（Proof of Work）上手签一次。
works.collective: Collectors bought 35,262 editions; on 28 May 2024 Butcher reported that all 35,262 signatures were done (artist's report, not an audited ledger).
works.collective_zh: 藏家共买下 35,262 个版数；2024 年 5 月 28 日 Butcher 报告 35,262 个签名全部完成（艺术家自述，并非审计记录）。

works.title: Full Set
works.description: Twenty-seven editions on an Ethereum layer 2 (with Rodeo). The first 26 images were replaced by one shared grid, and the 27th edition decided whether that change would last.
works.description_zh: 在以太坊二层网络上发行（与 Rodeo 合作）的 27 个版数。前 26 张图像被替换成一张共享网格，而第 27 个版数决定这一改变能否保留。
works.idea_en: A single collecting threshold that can rewrite, or undo, what earlier buyers own.
works.idea_zh: 一个收藏门槛，可以改写——也可以撤销——早先买家手中的作品。
works.protocol: On 10 January 2025 Butcher announced that if token 27 sold more than 159,300 editions (the combined count of the first 26), the network grid would remain the artwork; otherwise the first 26 would revert to their original images.
works.protocol_zh: 2025 年 1 月 10 日，Butcher 宣布：如果第 27 号代币的售出数量超过 159,300（前 26 个的总和），网格就成为最终作品；否则前 26 个将恢复原来的图像。
works.collective: Buyers of token 27 decided the outcome for holders of all earlier works. A progress post followed on 11 January, and the studio catalogue reports that the threshold was passed (the crossing transaction has not been published).
works.collective_zh: 第 27 号代币的买家替所有早期作品的持有者决定了结果。1 月 11 日有进度帖，工作室图录称门槛已被越过（越过门槛的那笔交易尚未公开）。

works.title: Self Checkout
works.description: A retail checkout installed at Art Basel Miami Beach (Zero 10, December 2025): visitors pay what they choose and receive a thermal receipt, which is the artwork, while a split-flap display shows the artist's running balance.
works.description_zh: 装在迈阿密巴塞尔艺博会（Zero 10，2025 年 12 月）里的一套自助收银台：观众自定金额付款，拿到一张热敏收据——收据就是作品；翻牌显示屏实时显示艺术家的收支余额。
works.idea_en: Take the jibe that an NFT is 'just a receipt' literally, and make every payment lengthen the work and move a public balance.
works.idea_zh: 把“NFT 不过是一张收据”这句讽刺当真：每一笔付款都让作品变长，并推动一个公开的余额。
works.protocol: Three in-person kiosks and one kiosk for remote orders accept any amount; each dollar adds length to the printed receipt. Each receipt carries a printed seed phrase giving access to a non-transferable digital companion on Ethereum. Online and in-person payments feed the same displayed balance, which started from the artist's own exhibition costs.
works.protocol_zh: 三台现场终端和一台远程订单终端接受任意金额；每一美元都会让打印出的收据更长。每张收据印有一组助记词，可访问以太坊上一个不可转让的数字伴生物。线上与现场付款汇入同一个公开余额，而余额的起点是艺术家自己承担的参展成本。
works.collective: Fair visitors and remote buyers paid varying amounts, lined up for signatures and pushed the displayed balance; press reports gave interim figures only, so no final total is recorded here.
works.collective_zh: 艺博会观众和远程买家付出不同金额、排队求签名，并推动显示屏上的余额变化；媒体只报道了中途数字，因此这里不记录最终总额。

works.title: Know Your Collector
works.description: A collection of synthetic portraits in which each participant tuned an invented face (seed, pose, expression, lighting, bands) and publicly linked their chosen configuration to their X account.
works.description_zh: 一组合成肖像：每位参与者调节一张虚构的脸（种子、姿态、表情、光线、条纹），并把自己选定的配置公开绑定到自己的 X 账号。
works.idea_en: Reverse KYC: instead of an institution identifying the customer, each collector chooses the invented face that will stand for them.
works.idea_zh: 反向的 KYC：不是机构识别客户，而是每位藏家挑选一张代表自己的虚构面孔。
works.protocol: Access came through a patron edition. Each participant configured a portrait rendered with Google's GNM head model, kept one configuration, and posted a public verification code from an established X account, linking an account to a choice.
works.protocol_zh: 参与资格来自一个赞助版数。每位参与者用谷歌 GNM 头部模型生成并调整肖像，保留一种配置，再从一个已有的 X 账号发布公开验证码，把账号与选择绑定。
works.collective: The studio's 19 August 2026 export holds 565 saved portraits, each a collector's choice rather than a likeness.
works.collective_zh: 工作室 2026 年 8 月 19 日的导出记录共有 565 幅已保存的肖像，每一幅都是一位藏家的选择，而非本人相貌。

works.title: Economy of Words
works.description: A card for each of the 2,048 words of the BIP39 seed-phrase list, each graded by a formula and sold in its own auction; winners then chose whether the card would exist as a physical graded card or as a synthetic card on Ethereum.
works.description_zh: 为 BIP39 助记词表的 2,048 个单词各做一张卡片，按公式评级，逐一拍卖；得标者再选择这张卡以实体评级卡还是以太坊上的合成卡的形式存在。
works.idea_en: Three hierarchies compete over the same words: a mechanical grade, what bidders pay, and the material form each winner picks.
works.idea_zh: 三种等级在同一批单词上竞争：机械评级、竞价者愿付的价格、以及每位得标者选择的材质形态。
works.protocol: Grades (10 bands) come from word length, initial letter, letter values and list position. Each auction opened at $1 and ran 20 hours 48 minutes, extended by late bids. Winners had 2,048 minutes after closing to choose physical or synthetic; the choice then locked.
works.protocol_zh: 评级（10 档）由单词长度、首字母、字母分值和在列表中的位置计算。每场拍卖以 1 美元起拍，持续 20 小时 48 分钟，临近结束有出价则延时。得标者在结拍后 2,048 分钟内选择实体或合成形态，之后不可更改。
works.collective: The studio's collector board ranks 331 holders of the 2,048 words by spend and shows the physical/synthetic split; final totals are not yet published.
works.collective_zh: 工作室的藏家榜按花费列出 2,048 个单词的 331 位持有者，并显示实体与合成的比例；最终总额尚未公布。

works.title: Credits
works.description: Each eligible $8 payment through X Money becomes a Credit, an image of four 8 × 8 CMYK grids derived from the transaction ID. Holders can burn 80 Credits to compose a Statement and overprint Statements onto each other.
works.description_zh: 每一笔符合条件、通过 X Money 支付的 8 美元都会生成一个 Credit：由交易编号生成的四个 8 × 8 CMYK 网格。持有者可以销毁 80 个 Credit 组成一个 Statement，再把 Statement 相互叠印。
works.idea_en: Payment records as printing plates: collectors spend trust (credits) to make fewer, denser prints.
works.idea_zh: 把付款记录当作印版：藏家花掉“信用”，换来更少、更厚重的印张。
works.protocol: A transaction ID is hashed (SHA-256) into 256 bits, split into cyan, magenta, yellow and black 64-bit grids; the timestamp selects which layers show. Burning 80 Credits composes a Statement, one Credit per cell. Overprinting one Statement onto another burns the top one and multiplies the inks. Statements are capped at 1,526 and the minimum is 1.
works.protocol_zh: 交易编号经 SHA-256 哈希得到 256 位，分成青、品红、黄、黑四个 64 位网格；时间戳决定显示哪些层。销毁 80 个 Credit 组成一个 Statement，每个 Credit 填一个格子。把一个 Statement 叠印到另一个上，上层被销毁，油墨相乘。Statement 最多 1,526 个，最少 1 个。
works.collective: Credits are being issued from X Money payments; Statement assembly opens on 1 October 2026, so how far collectors will compress the supply is not yet known.
works.collective_zh: Credit 正随着 X Money 付款不断生成；Statement 的组装于 2026 年 10 月 1 日开放，藏家会把供应压缩到什么程度尚不可知。

works.title: Work, Luck, Play
works.description: Silver sculptures and a trading game presented by Silk at Art Basel Hong Kong (March 2026): a dice roll gave each participant six resin dice, and participants traded with each other to complete a set of one to six.
works.description_zh: 由 Silk 在香港巴塞尔艺博会（2026 年 3 月）呈现的银雕塑与交换游戏：掷一次普通骰子决定每位参与者得到哪六颗树脂骰子，参与者相互交换，凑齐一到六的整套。
works.idea_en: Separate effort, fixed luck and choices made together: the finished set can only come from trading with strangers.
works.idea_zh: 把努力、注定的运气和共同的选择分开：完整的一套只能靠与陌生人交换得来。
works.protocol: A roll of ordinary dice decided which six resin dice a visitor received (Luck's dice carry one number on every face). Participants could trade to assemble 1 through 6 and return for a signed set, or keep an incomplete combination. An online rolling system on Ethereum and a token-burning route to claim a silver die ran alongside.
works.protocol_zh: 掷一次普通骰子，决定观众拿到哪六颗树脂骰子（Luck 系列的骰子每一面都是同一个数字）。参与者可以交换凑齐 1 到 6，回来换一套签名套装，也可以保留不完整的组合。同时还有以太坊上的线上掷骰系统，以及通过销毁代币领取银骰子的途径。
works.collective: Fair visitors traded dice among themselves to complete sets, and an accumulating archive ('Luckiest') recorded the rolls; no participant counts have been published.
works.collective_zh: 艺博会观众彼此交换骰子来凑齐整套，一个不断累积的档案（“Luckiest”）记录下每次掷骰；参与人数尚未公布。

works.title: The Currency
works.description: 10,000 NFTs, each tied to a unique hand-painted dot work on paper, released with HENI in July 2021. Each buyer had a year to keep the NFT or swap it for the painting; whichever was not chosen was destroyed.
works.description_zh: 与 HENI 合作于 2021 年 7 月发行的 10,000 个 NFT，每个对应一幅独一无二的纸上手绘点画。每位买家有一年时间决定保留 NFT 还是换成画作；没被选中的那一方会被销毁。
works.idea_en: Make every owner choose between the token and the object, and let the sum of those choices decide how much of the work physically survives.
works.idea_zh: 让每位藏家在代币与实物之间二选一，这些选择的总和决定作品有多少以实体形式留存。
works.protocol: Holders of each NFT (on the Palm blockchain) could, until 27 July 2022, exchange it for the matching paper work, which burned the NFT; if they kept the NFT, the paper work would be burned. Hirst kept 1,000 works himself and chose the NFT for them, so their papers burned too.
works.protocol_zh: 每个 NFT（在 Palm 区块链上）的持有者在 2022 年 7 月 27 日前可以换取对应的纸本作品，此时 NFT 被销毁；若保留 NFT，纸本作品就会被烧掉。赫斯特自己保留了 1,000 件并选择保留 NFT，所以这些纸本也被烧掉。
works.collective: When the exchange period closed, 5,149 holders had chosen the physical work and 4,851 the NFT (HENI). The 4,851 papers were burned publicly during The Currency exhibition at Newport Street Gallery, London, from September to October 2022, starting on 11 October with Hirst's own 1,000.
works.collective_zh: 兑换期结束时，5,149 位持有者选择了实物，4,851 位选择了 NFT（据 HENI）。2022 年 9 月至 10 月，这 4,851 张纸本在伦敦 Newport Street Gallery 的 The Currency 展览中被当众焚烧，10 月 11 日从赫斯特自己保留的 1,000 张开始。

works.title: Rocket Factory
works.description: 3,000 NFT rocket parts (nose cones, bodies, tail assemblies) in 30 brand liveries. Collectors combine three parts into a rocket, and may ask the studio to build and launch a physical twin.
works.description_zh: 3,000 个 NFT 火箭零件（箭头、箭身、尾翼），共 30 种品牌涂装。藏家把三个零件组合成一枚火箭，还可以请工作室造出实体孪生火箭并发射。
works.idea_en: The collector base, not the artist, decides which of 113,000+ possible rockets get built, and the studio has to follow.
works.idea_zh: 由藏家群体而非艺术家决定 113,000 多种可能中哪些火箭被造出来，工作室只能照做。
works.protocol: One nose cone, one body and one tail assembly can be combined into a Completed Rocket NFT; the three component NFTs are burned ('comburning'). Same-brand parts make a Perfect Rocket, mixed parts a Frankenrocket. A rocket holder can choose the Launch Option, after which the studio builds and launches a physical rocket and returns recovered parts in a display box with launch video; the physical twin can also be donated or destroyed.
works.protocol_zh: 一个箭头、一个箭身和一个尾翼可以组合成一枚 Completed Rocket NFT，三个零件 NFT 随之销毁（“comburning”）。同品牌零件组成 Perfect Rocket，混搭则是 Frankenrocket。火箭持有者可以选择发射选项：工作室造出实体火箭并发射，把回收的零件装进展示盒、连同发射视频寄回；实体孪生也可以选择捐赠或销毁。
works.collective: Collectors trade parts to chase scarce Perfect Rockets (for example 87 Chanel and 3 Hello Kitty sets exist). By the 2022 Wallpaper* Design Awards there had been seven public launches, including Governors Island in New York, a Miami ballpark and SoHo; LACMA joined with a collaborative Frankenrocket.
works.collective_zh: 藏家交换零件以追逐稀有的 Perfect Rocket（例如 Chanel 套件只有 87 套，Hello Kitty 只有 3 套）。到 2022 年 Wallpaper* 设计奖评选时已公开发射七次，地点包括纽约总督岛、迈阿密一座棒球场和苏荷区；洛杉矶郡立美术馆也参与组装了一枚合作 Frankenrocket。

works.title: Digital Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility
works.description: An ERC-20 token work deployed on 29 August 2017 and unveiled at InterAccess, Toronto. It restages Yves Klein's Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility, including a ritual any holder can perform to destroy their token.
works.description_zh: 2017 年 8 月 29 日部署、在多伦多 InterAccess 首次展出的 ERC-20 代币作品。它重演伊夫·克莱因的《非物质绘画感性区域》，包括任何持有者都能执行、销毁自己代币的仪式。
works.idea_en: Put an artist's sale ritual in a contract: buyers must deal with the contract directly, and 'owning the immaterial' means burning the receipt.
works.idea_zh: 把艺术家的出售仪式写进合约：买家必须直接与合约打交道，“拥有非物质”意味着烧掉收据。
works.protocol: IKB is sold only by calling the contract's buy() function (no front end, on purpose). Supply is capped at 101 tokens in 8 series: Series 0 has 31 tokens at 0.1 ETH, each later series 10 tokens at double the previous price, with later series meant to be released over the artist's lifetime. Every sale is recorded per edition. A holder may call ritual(): the token is burned and half the ETH paid for it is sent to a separate contract called theRiver, echoing Klein throwing half the gold into the Seine.
works.protocol_zh: IKB 只能通过直接调用合约的 buy() 函数购买（刻意不做前端）。总量上限 101 枚，分 8 个系列：第 0 系列 31 枚、每枚 0.1 ETH，之后每个系列 10 枚、价格翻倍，后续系列按计划在艺术家一生中陆续发行。每次出售都按版次记录。持有者可调用 ritual()：代币被销毁，买它所付 ETH 的一半被转入名为 theRiver 的另一个合约，呼应克莱因把一半黄金抛入塞纳河。
works.collective: All Series 0 tokens sold out (artist's README, 2021); buyers had to work out how to call the contract by hand. The contract records each edition's buyer, price and whether it has been ritually burned.
works.collective_zh: 第 0 系列全部售罄（艺术家 2021 年的说明）；买家必须自己弄清如何手动调用合约。合约记录了每个版次的买家、价格以及是否已被仪式销毁。

leads.name: Archillect (Pak, 2014)
leads.why: AI image curator whose picks respond to audience engagement; followers give feedback but do not act under an authored rule, so it fails test 2–3.

leads.name: The Switch (Pak, 2021)
leads.why: 1/1 whose owner can call a function once to change it; a single-owner mechanic, not collective behaviour.

leads.name: Fomo (Pak, 2021)
leads.why: Free mint with fixed supply and a 50% secondary fee framed as partnership; check whether the fee rule shaped holder behaviour.

leads.name: Hate (Pak, 2022)
leads.why: Tokens issued to critics and later moved to a burn address by Pak; the rule acts on individuals, not a group.

leads.name: The Title (Pak, 2021)
leads.why: Identical NFTs sold under different titles and pricing; a comment on framing without collective rules.

leads.name: ASH Chapter II: Metamorphosis (Pak, March 2022)
leads.why: Second ASH-only drop; mechanics not yet documented.

leads.name: 404: The Presence of Absence (Pak)
leads.why: Mentioned by collectors as a Pak project; date and rules unknown.

leads.name: Pak open editions on Nifty Gateway (Project X, 2020)
leads.why: Early time-limited open editions credited to Pak; context for The Fungible and Merge rather than a separate protocol work.

leads.name: Checks Elements (Jack Butcher, 2023)
leads.why: Monoprints paired with tokens; no collector mechanism.

leads.name: Gas Wars (Jack Butcher, 2025)
leads.why: Art Blocks release where price follows token number in a 500-second window; a mint mechanic, collective behaviour only predicted.

leads.name: Wrappers (Jack Butcher, 2026)
leads.why: 80 images distributed by blind draw; holders have no rule to act on.

leads.name: VV Editions: Humanity Check, 100 Meals (Jack Butcher, 2021)
leads.why: Early 'infinite editions' by Visualize Value; check whether supply rules were a declared part of the work.

leads.name: Hashmasks (Suum Cuique Labs, 2021)
leads.why: 16,384 portraits whose names are set by holders by burning NCT tokens; collective naming as co-authorship.

leads.name: Sam Spratt, The Monument Game (2023)
leads.why: Holders of Spratt's works play a game that shapes the Luci narrative; possible co-authorship protocol.

leads.name: Mad Dog Jones, REPLICATOR (2021)
leads.why: A 1/1 that generates new editions over time; reproduction without a group rule.

leads.name: Sarah Meyohas, Bitchcoin (2015)
leads.why: Token backed by photographs, redeemable by burning; early supply/provenance work (check the provenance batch first).

leads.name: Burnt Banksy (2021)
leads.why: A bought Banksy print burned and minted as an NFT by a company; no artist-authored protocol.

leads.name: Damien Hirst, other HENI NFT projects (2022–2023)
leads.why: Check whether later HENI releases reused The Currency's choice-and-burn rule.

leads.name: Kevin Abosch, Forever Rose / IAMA Coin (2018)
leads.why: A 1/1 split among 10 co-owners and a 10-million-token self-portrait; ownership rules, not yet researched.

leads.name: Alexis André, Friendship Bracelets (2022)
leads.why: Generative bracelets meant to be gifted; possible circulation protocol.
